prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
`mkdir` is the portable test-and-set command. Automake’s suggested locking pattern is:

```make
@if test -f $@; then :; else \
  trap 'rm -rf data.lock data.stamp' 1 2 13 15; \
  if mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null; then \
    rm -f data.stamp; \
    $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) data.stamp; \
    result=$$?; rm -rf data.lock; exit $$result; \
  else \
    while test -d data.lock; do sleep 1; done; \
    test -f data.stamp; \
  fi; \
fi
```

The first process successfully creates `data.lock`, rebuilds the stamp, and removes the lock. Other processes wait until the lock directory disappears, then succeed only if `data.stamp` exists.
